name: SpamCop Blocking List (bl.spamcop.net)
tier_rationale: Operated by Cisco Talos: an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted).

reliability.justification: Automated listing from user spam reports with a short expiry: usually right about current spam sources, never about other abuse.

bl.title: SpamCop BL (DNS A answer 127.0.0.2 = listed; TXT gives the reason)

terms.quote: P045 cond 1 (binding council text): Per-list terms registry; a list is wired only once its entry is recorded. SpamCop and DroneBL are 'open' within their free-use terms.

bl.notes: Quote: binding council text (P045 cond 1); research C0083 (SpamCop test point 2.0.0.127.bl.spamcop.net answered 127.0.0.2 through Cloudflare DoH, 2026-11-26). Queried through the core DoH layer (it answers public resolvers). Used by dnsbl.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G02-2 (P045). DNS only: the list is queried through DNS A lookups (core DoH layer or the system resolver), never over HTTP, so the provider has no HTTP host. Every DNSBL counts as ONE 'spam' family vote in P171 consensus (upstream_family 'dnsbl', P045 cond 8).
